chapter.chapter: Chapter 2 — Exploring Substances: Acidic, Basic, and Neutral

excerpts:
[CBSE Class X Science, sample question paper, 2022-23]
6. Anita added a drop each of diluted acetic acid and diluted hydrochloric acid on pH paper 1
and compared the colors. Which of the following is the correct conclusion?
(a) pH of acetic acid is more than that of hydrochloric acid.
(b) pH of acetic acid is less than that of hydrochloric acid.
(c) Acetic acid dissociates completely in aqueous solution.
(d) Acetic acid is a strong acid

[CBSE Class X Science, sample question paper, 2024-25]
4. An aqueous solution ‘A’ turns the phenolphthalein solution pink. On addition of
an aqueous solution ‘B’ to ‘A’, the pink colour disappears. Which of the following 1
statement is true for the solutions ‘A’ and ‘B’.
A. A is strongly basic and B is a weak base.
B. A is strongly acidic and B is a weak acid.
C. A has a pH greater than 7 and B has a pH less than 7.
D. A has a pH less than 7 and B has a pH greater than 7.

[INJSO 2016 — question paper]
21. Anand wanted to prepare a salt solution of pH 1.0. For that he used solutions of a
strong monovalent base and acid. He tried different combinations to obtain the
required solution. Can you help him to decide which one is the most correct
combination of statements given below?
I. 100ml of (M/10) acid and 100ml of (M/10) alkali.
II. 55ml of (M/10) acid and 45ml of (M/10) alkali.
III. 10ml of (M/10) acid and 90ml of (M/10) alkali.
IV. 75ml of (M/5) acid and 25ml of (M/5) alkali
a) I and III b) II and IV
c) Only II d) Only IV

[CBSE Class X Science, sample question paper, 2025-26]
21. Which of the following substances when dissolved in equal volume of water,
will have the highest pH value? 1
A. Sulphuric acid
B. Acetic acid
C. Magnesium hydroxide
D. Sodium hydroxide

Solution B turns the red rose extract green and changes the turmeric paper to red. Solution C does not change the red rose extract and does not change the turmeric paper. Which of the following best classifies these solutions?

A solution turns red litmus to blue. Which of the following could be the solution?

You are provided with three unknown solutions labelled A, B, and C. Upon adding a few drops of red litmus solution to solution A, it turns blue. When a few drops of turmeric solution are added to solution B, it turns red. Finally, after adding a few drops of red rose extract to solution C, it turns green. Based on the observations, which of the following is the correct sequence for the nature of solutions A, B, and C?

Why is it important to neutralise acidic soil?

Which of the following is an example of a basic substance?
Which of the following substances is likely to have the highest pH value when dissolved in water?
A student tested a sample with both blue and red litmus paper. The blue litmus turned red, and the red litmus remained unchanged. What can be concluded about the sample?
If a substance turns red litmus paper blue, what can be concluded about its nature?
A student tested a solution and found that it did not change the color of either blue or red litmus paper. What can be concluded about the solution?
Which of the following is an example of an olfactory indicator?
What happens when an acidic solution is mixed with a basic solution?
Which substance changes colour in acidic and basic solutions?
Manya is blindfolded. She is given two unknown solutions to test and determine whether they are acidic or basic. Which indicator should Manya use to test the solutions and why?
A liquid sample from the laboratory was tested using various indicators. Based on the tests, identify the acidic or basic nature of the liquid and justify your answer.
What happens when an acid is mixed with a base in sufficient quantity?
In the experiment described, what caused the colour change from red to blue?
